ability_gauging.line: Read anyone's power at a glance, without a fight.
ability_gauging.name: Ability Gauging

nodes.d: Turn it on to scan. Your eyes glow.
Look at someone close and press. Learn everything about their power.
Turn the scope on, then right-click someone far away to read them.

ability_gauging_am.line: Read anyone's power at a glance, without a fight.
ability_gauging_am.name: Ability Gauging

nodes.d: Look at someone close and press. Learn everything about their power.
Turn the scope on, then right-click someone far away to read them.

arachnid.line: Eight spider legs from your back. They hit from far off, and they climb walls.
arachnid.name: Arachnid

nodes.d: Turn it on. Eight spider legs grow from your back.
The legs stab everything in front of you, three times over.
Curl the legs around you. They block hits and swat arrows away.
The legs throw you into the air. Landing shoves foes back.
Lunge forward, legs first. Everything beside you gets impaled.

arachnid_am.line: Eight spider legs from your back. They hit from far off, and they climb walls.
arachnid_am.name: Arachnid

nodes.d: The legs stab everything in front of you, three times over.
Curl the legs around you. They block hits and swat arrows away.
The legs throw you into the air. Landing shoves foes back.
Lunge forward, legs first. Everything beside you gets impaled.

arcane_shot.line: Precise aura bolts that burst on impact. They're quick and cheap.
arcane_shot.name: Arcane Shot

nodes.d: Turn it on. Your aura becomes bolts.
Hold to charge, let go to fire. The longer the charge, the bigger the bolt.
Fan seven bolts out in front of you.

arcane_shot_am.line: Precise aura bolts that burst on impact. They're quick and cheap.
arcane_shot_am.name: Arcane Shot

nodes.d: Hold to charge, let go to fire. The longer the charge, the bigger the bolt.
Fan seven bolts out in front of you.

arcroot.line: Vines and lightning. Crack a shock whip or drain a foe through a tether. Roots erupt along your aim.
arcroot.name: Arcroot

nodes.d: Turn it on. Take up the shock lash.
Crack the whip. It shocks the target and pulls it in.
Latch onto a target and drain it. Hold on to the end and it pops.
Roots erupt along your aim, one after another. The last one explodes.

arcroot_am.line: Vines and lightning. Crack a shock whip or drain a foe through a tether. Roots erupt along your aim.
arcroot_am.name: Arcroot

nodes.d: Crack the whip. It shocks the target and pulls it in.
Latch onto a target and drain it. Hold on to the end and it pops.
Roots erupt along your aim, one after another. The last one explodes.

armament_dominion.line: Claim what you beat, then draw it back out as a weapon.
armament_dominion.name: Armament Dominion

nodes.d: Turn it on. What you claim becomes your arsenal.
Claim the item in your hand, or a weakened creature. Sneak + press to judge its worth.
Swap to your next armament. Sneak + press to put it away.
Hold to pack aura into your fingertip, let go to fire. It pierces.
Every armament you own flies at your target.

armament_dominion_am.line: Claim what you beat, then draw it back out as a weapon.
armament_dominion_am.name: Armament Dominion

nodes.d: Claim the item in your hand, or a weakened creature. Sneak + press to judge its worth.
Swap to your next armament. Sneak + press to put it away.
Hold to pack aura into your fingertip, let go to fire. It pierces.
Every armament you own flies at your target.

armor_suit.line: Heavy steel plates over your body. You're tough and hard to knock back.
armor_suit.name: Armor Suit

nodes.d: Turn it on. Steel plates cover your body.
Plant your feet. You take less, and melee attackers bounce off.
Shoulder-check forward. The first foe you hit staggers.
Blast your plates off in a ring. They grow right back.
Throw five plates in a fan. Whatever they hit loses armor.

armor_suit_am.line: Heavy steel plates over your body. You're tough and hard to knock back.
armor_suit_am.name: Armor Suit

nodes.d: Plant your feet. You take less, and melee attackers bounce off.
Shoulder-check forward. The first foe you hit staggers.
Blast your plates off in a ring. They grow right back.
Throw five plates in a fan. Whatever they hit loses armor.

aura_manipulation.line: Copy the powers near you. Their best stats become yours.
aura_manipulation.name: Aura Manipulation

nodes.d: Turn it on. Feel the powers around you.
Open the wheel and pick a power to copy.
Sneak + press to let every copy go.

aura_shred_am.line: Shred aura off your foes, then spend what you took.
aura_shred_am.name: Aura Shred

nodes.d: Turn it on. Foes near you and foes you punch gather shreds. A powered foe's burst is stored as aura.
Swap between Combat and Redemption.
Leave a shred on a target. It keeps tearing at them, and you can see them.
Latch onto a target and keep shredding while you stay close.
Lock every shred you've left. They grow, then burst.
Spend stored aura to refill your own.
Spend stored aura to raise your power for a while.
Spend stored aura to weaken everyone around you.

aura_transference.line: Hit powered people bare-handed to take their traits. Weave them into weapons or people.
aura_transference.name: Aura Transference

nodes.d: Turn it on. Hit a powered being with an empty hand to take a trait.
Pick the trait to use. Sneak + press to pull out the last one you wove.
Weave the trait into the weapon in your hand.
Weave the trait into someone you look at. Sneak + press for yourself.

aura_transference_am.line: Hit powered people bare-handed to take their traits. Weave them into weapons or people.
aura_transference_am.name: Aura Transference

nodes.d: Pick the trait to use. Sneak + press to pull out the last one you wove.
Weave the trait into the weapon in your hand.
Weave the trait into someone you look at. Sneak + press for yourself.

azure_storm.line: Your own storm. A tornado around you, a wall of wind, flight, a piercing lance.
azure_storm.name: Azure Storm

nodes.d: Turn it on. The wind lifts your jumps and softens your falls.
Wrap yourself in a tornado. It throws everything nearby away.
Slam up a wall of wind. Shots bounce back and foes are shoved away.
Fly on the wind. Jump to rise and sprint to soar. Sneak to come down.
Fire a spinning spear of wind. It pierces and launches.

azure_storm_am.line: Your own storm. A tornado around you, a wall of wind, flight, a piercing lance.
azure_storm_am.name: Azure Storm

nodes.d: Wrap yourself in a tornado. It throws everything nearby away.
Slam up a wall of wind. Shots bounce back and foes are shoved away.
Fly on the wind. Jump to rise and sprint to soar. Sneak to come down.
Fire a spinning spear of wind. It pierces and launches.

barrier.line: Walls of force. Armor while it's on, and shells anywhere that send half of each blow back.
barrier.name: Barrier

nodes.d: Turn it on. Your body is armored.
Raise a shell around you. It cracks as it takes hits and sends half of each one back.
Make all your barriers bigger.
Dash forward behind a shield. Foes scatter.

barrier_am.line: Walls of force. Armor while it's on, and shells anywhere that send half of each blow back.
barrier_am.name: Barrier

nodes.d: Raise a shell around you. It cracks as it takes hits and sends half of each one back.
Make all your barriers bigger.
Dash forward behind a shield. Foes scatter.

black_lash.line: Dark tendrils with a teal edge. Once a day they hold you together through a killing blow.
black_lash.name: Black Lash

nodes.d: Turn it on. Tendrils grow from your arms. Push them too hard and they take over, feeding on you.
Light things come, heavy ones pull you. Hold high to swing or sneak to slingshot. To pound, aim down mid-air.
Seize and carry a target. Press on another to take it too, or anywhere else to throw them. Sneak to slam.
Three whip cracks at the nearest foe. Sneak for the Lash Ward: tendrils whirl around you.
Needs half your Strain. Eight tendrils whip everyone around you, then slam down together.

black_lash_am.line: Dark tendrils with a teal edge. Once a day they hold you together through a killing blow.
black_lash_am.name: Black Lash

nodes.d: Light things come, heavy ones pull you. Hold high to swing or sneak to slingshot. To pound, aim down mid-air.
Seize and carry a target. Press on another to take it too, or anywhere else to throw them. Sneak to slam.

blademaster.line: Blades made of aura. Swords, knives, arcs, and a storm of them.
blademaster.name: Blademaster

nodes.d: Turn it on. You swing and move faster.
Draw two aura katanas. Press again to put them away.
Throw a fast aura knife. Headshots cut deeper.
Launch a crescent of aura. It flies far and pierces.
Blades burst from your body and push everything back.
A rain of blades falls on the area you target.

blademaster_am.line: Blades made of aura. Swords, knives, arcs, and a storm of them.
blademaster_am.name: Blademaster

nodes.d: Draw two aura katanas. Press again to put them away.
Throw a fast aura knife. Headshots cut deeper.
Launch a crescent of aura. It flies far and pierces.
Blades burst from your body and push everything back.
A rain of blades falls on the area you target.

blizzard.line: Wind and frost. Wrap yourself in a whiteout and send out frost cyclones. Then shatter what you froze.
blizzard.name: Blizzard

nodes.d: Turn it on. The cold is yours.
Wrap yourself in a blizzard. Foes inside slow down, then freeze.
Send a frost cyclone rolling forward. It drags and freezes.
Freeze everything around you. Whatever was already frozen shatters.

blizzard_am.line: Wind and frost. Wrap yourself in a whiteout and send out frost cyclones. Then shatter what you froze.
blizzard_am.name: Blizzard

nodes.d: Wrap yourself in a blizzard. Foes inside slow down, then freeze.
Send a frost cyclone rolling forward. It drags and freezes.
Freeze everything around you. Whatever was already frozen shatters.

boon_projection.line: A Dealmaker's boon. Step out of your body.
boon_projection.name: Boon of Projection

nodes.d: The boon is yours while the deal holds.
Step out of your body and fly. Press again, or take a hit, to go back.

boon_travel.line: A Dealmaker's boon. Two doors, one step apart.
boon_travel.name: Boon of Travel

nodes.d: The boon is yours while the deal holds.
Mark a door, then sneak + press to mark the second. Walk through one and you come out the other.

catalyst_ray.line: Unstable rays that mutate whatever they hit. Good or bad, you never know.
catalyst_ray.name: Catalyst Ray

nodes.d: Turn it on. Little sparks flicker around you.
Fire a bolt that gives a random mutation.
Touch something to strip its mutations away.
Touch something so mutations stack on it without limit, for a while.
Touch something with one mutation to make it stay.

catalyst_ray_am.line: Unstable rays that mutate whatever they hit. Good or bad, you never know.
catalyst_ray_am.name: Catalyst Ray

nodes.d: Fire a bolt that gives a random mutation.
Touch something to strip its mutations away.
Touch something so mutations stack on it without limit, for a while.
Touch something with one mutation to make it stay.

chained_one.line: ORIGIN N. The Whole the Ten were broken from. Raise the Mantle and nothing gets through.
chained_one.name: The Chained One

nodes.d: Wake in your Negation: the Wings, two chain-tails, two rakes. The Legion's key raises the Mantle.
Hold for the Shapes wheel. Tap for the Shape's move.
Tap to lash the nearest with chain-tails. Hold to bind them, let go to slam.
Meteors fall where you look.
Hold for the Legion's wheel, then click to call. Deaths near you give you souls.
Open or close the Tatterwings.
Five rakes in a breath. Each leaves a cut in the air.
Everything near you is forced to its knees.
Charge through earth and stone. Whatever's in the way is thrown aside.
Both claws tear two crescents of force forward.
Hold to pour out a violet beam. It carves a trench.
Ten chains in the Ten's colors fall where you look.
Two rakes in a breath, each leaving a cut in the air. The Sovereign's claws rake five.
Raise the Mantle for good: it holds until you fall. The first rise of each day is the Descent.

conjure_disks.line: Spinning aura disks. They shield you and fly where you throw them. You can ride one too.
conjure_disks.name: Conjure: Disks

nodes.d: Turn it on to conjure a pool of razor disks. You get more as you level.
Two disks circle you and take the hits. You move a little slower.
Throw a disk in a straight line. It cuts and pushes.
Ride a disk. Jump to lift off and sprint to glide. Sneak to come down.

conjure_disks_am.line: Spinning aura disks. They shield you and fly where you throw them. You can ride one too.
conjure_disks_am.name: Conjure: Disks

nodes.d: Two disks circle you and take the hits. You move a little slower.
Throw a disk in a straight line. It cuts and pushes.
Ride a disk. Jump to lift off and sprint to glide. Sneak to come down.

conjure_vines.line: Living green vines. Grab, bind, stab, and cover the ground in them.
conjure_vines.name: Conjure: Vines

nodes.d: Turn it on. Your vines are always green.
Hold to steer a vine. It whips what it touches and drags the first foe it catches.
Throw binding vines. Whoever they hit can't run or jump.
Fire five vine spikes in a spread.
Hold to grow a field of vines. Everything inside slows down.

conjure_vines_am.line: Living green vines. Grab, bind, stab, and cover the ground in them.
conjure_vines_am.name: Conjure: Vines

nodes.d: Hold to steer a vine. It whips what it touches and drags the first foe it catches.
Throw binding vines. Whoever they hit can't run or jump.
Fire five vine spikes in a spread.
Hold to grow a field of vines. Everything inside slows down.

contact_shred.line: A touch that cuts later. Your hits leave marks that tear open.
contact_shred.name: Contact Shred

nodes.d: Turn it on. Your hits leave marks that tear open.
Grab someone close. When you let go, the mark tears them open.
Dash through foes. Everyone you pass is marked.

contact_shred_am.line: A touch that cuts later. Your hits leave marks that tear open.
contact_shred_am.name: Contact Shred

nodes.d: Grab someone close. When you let go, the mark tears them open.
Dash through foes. Everyone you pass is marked.

counterweight.line: ORIGIN IX. Everything thrown at him is a deposit, returned with interest.
counterweight.name: Counterweight

nodes.d: Turn it on. Every hit you catch is force you can spend.
Tap to parry: catch a hit and bank its force. Time it perfectly for more.
A perfect catch keeps catching every blow that follows, for a moment.
Hold Absorb to keep your guard up. It catches less, but it lasts.
Empty the bank into a cone of air that knocks everyone over.
Sneak + Wave: spend the force down and back, and bound the way you look. You land soft.
Load the bank into your next punch. It explodes on contact.
Sneak + Fist: turn banked force into health, slowly.
Narrow the whole bank into one lance. It goes through everyone in line.
Your guard catches arrows too.
The bank holds more.
Your guard catches explosions.
The Point opens.
A perfect catch goes straight back where it came from without spending the bank.

crescent_slash.line: Fast crescent blades of energy that you throw from range.
crescent_slash.name: Crescent Slash

nodes.d: Turn it on. Your crescents wear your aura and eye colors.
Hold to charge a crescent, let go to throw it. Charge longer for a bigger one.
Throw two crescents ahead of you.
Throw five small crescents in a quick fan.
Hold to gather a huge crescent, let go to send it. It cuts through everything in line.

crescent_slash_am.line: Fast crescent blades of energy that you throw from range.
crescent_slash_am.name: Crescent Slash

nodes.d: Hold to charge a crescent, let go to throw it. Charge longer for a bigger one.
Throw two crescents ahead of you.
Throw five small crescents in a quick fan.
Hold to gather a huge crescent, let go to send it. It cuts through everything in line.

crimson_mark.line: ORIGIN VI. Stare at someone until a red thread glows. Then their fate is yours to cut.
crimson_mark.name: Crimson Mark

nodes.d: Look at someone and hold the stare. A red thread grows between you.
Cut every thread at once. Each cut wounds its target.
Sneak + Sever: string a thread between two points. Whatever walks in is caught.
Shoot a thread into the sky and swing.
Sneak + Thread Step: hang in the air and fight from your threads.
Tie two marked targets together. What hits one hits the other.
Sneak + Redirection: tie someone to yourself. Your next wound is theirs.
Fling crimson clots in a fan. Each one heals you a little.
Your bare hands carry the weave. Sneak to swing a hammer instead.
Sneak + Loom: a huge cage of strings. Nobody leaves until it falls.
Thread Step opens, and you can string triplines.
Redirection opens.
The Loom opens, and your hands carry the weave.
Sever stops what they were casting, and you can hang in the air.
The Strings of Destiny open.

daystar.line: Strength that follows the sun. Strongest at noon, weakest at midnight.
daystar.name: Daystar

nodes.d: Turn it on. You grow with the sun, and near noon you burn what's close.
Draw a great axe out of the light. Its swings burn. Sneak to throw it, press again to call it back.
Hold to grow a sun on one finger, release to throw. Sneak to flare it around you, aim down mid-air to drop it.
Split the ground in a long line of fire. Sneak to fan it or look up to fling it. To dive, aim down mid-air.
Only at noon, once a day. For a minute, almost nothing hurts you.

daystar_am.line: Strength that follows the sun. Strongest at noon, weakest at midnight.
daystar_am.name: Daystar

deadeye_am.line: Predator and Energy Discharge. Mark them, and every beam finds them.
deadeye_am.name: Deadeye

nodes.d: Fire a beam that bends to follow your marked target.
Hold to fire streams of homing beams from your fingers.
A shockwave in every direction. Marked foes are hit harder.
Hold to charge a rail shot, let go to fire. Longer charge, bigger beam.
Mark every foe around you for a while.

dealmaker.line: ORIGIN VII. Everything he has, someone signed away to him.
dealmaker.name: The Dealmaker

nodes.d: Write contracts that enforce themselves. Anyone can petition the Dealmaker.
Write a blank contract, or void the unsigned one you carry.
Choose which owned soul your seals act on. Sneak to choose every soul you hold.
Pull the chosen souls to you across the world. Sneak to go to the first of them instead.
Draw a soul into your hand. Sneak with that soul in hand to rip it to shreds.
The same switch as the first bar, on the second. Sneak it while the Dealmaker is on to open the Ledger.
Bind the soul in front of you to a seat. Sneak to choose the seat.
Take a bound ally's wounds as your own. Press again to let go. Sneak to choose the seat.
Raise a bound ally's rank for a while. Sneak to choose the seat.
Spend your lowest bound seat for power of your own.
Turn it on. Your hands become demon claws.
Your hits become claw slashes.
Pounce forward and slash the first foe you reach.
A heavy cross-slash at everything in front of you.
A feral stance. Bigger claws, faster feet.
Your hits become claw slashes.
Pounce forward and slash the first foe you reach.
A heavy cross-slash at everything in front of you.
A feral stance. Bigger claws, faster feet.

disguise.line: A stolen shape. You look and sound like someone else.
disguise.name: Stolen Shape

nodes.d: You wear someone else's name and voice. Your face stays your own.
Shed the stolen shape.

dizzy_punch.line: Punches that make the world spin. Every hit leaves them sick.
dizzy_punch.name: Dizzy Punch

nodes.d: Turn it on. Your hits make people sick. Three in a row and they stagger.
Wind up. Your next punch flips their controls.
Feint, then hook from the blind side. It hits harder if they were watching you.
Sway like you've had a few. Hits on you land soft.

dizzy_punch_am.line: Punches that make the world spin. Every hit leaves them sick.
dizzy_punch_am.name: Dizzy Punch

nodes.d: Wind up. Your next punch flips their controls.
Feint, then hook from the blind side. It hits harder if they were watching you.
Sway like you've had a few. Hits on you land soft.

edict.line: ORIGIN I. He passes laws that make your power illegal.
edict.name: Edict

nodes.d: Pass laws over a court around you. You earn Precedent while it's contested.
Strike the gavel. The pending law takes hold over a dome at your feet.
Strike your own law early. The dome falls.
A giant hand of law slams down on the ground you target.
Write law on your own body: strength and endurance in golden script.
Sneak + Pass Law: turn to the next pending law.
Sneak + Hands of the Law: grab the offender and fling them.
Sneak + Decrees: for a few seconds, harm against you is struck from the record.

energy_conduit.line: Aura links to anyone. Share aura, steal it, heal through it, reel people in.
energy_conduit.name: Energy Conduit

nodes.d: Turn it on to link yourself to others. Turning it off cuts every link.
Throw a loop of aura. Whatever it hits is linked to you.
Hold to give your aura to linked allies.
Hold to heal linked allies with your aura.
Hold to reel everyone you're linked to toward you.

energy_conduit_am.line: Aura links to anyone. Share aura, steal it, heal through it, reel people in.
energy_conduit_am.name: Energy Conduit

nodes.d: Throw a loop of aura. Whatever it hits is linked to you.
Hold to give your aura to linked allies.
Hold to heal linked allies with your aura.
Hold to reel everyone you're linked to toward you.

energy_discharge.line: Raw energy. Beams, spheres, bursts, and a push that throws you.
energy_discharge.name: Energy Discharge

nodes.d: Turn it on. Your energy is ready.
Hold to fire a long beam. Sneak as you press it to charge the Energy Wave.
Launch an energy sphere. It explodes on impact.
Blast everything near you away.
Throw yourself the way you face. No fall damage.

energy_discharge_am.line: Raw energy. Beams, spheres, bursts, and a push that throws you.
energy_discharge_am.name: Energy Discharge

nodes.d: Hold to fire a long beam. Sneak as you press it to charge the Energy Wave.
Launch an energy sphere. It explodes on impact.
Blast everything near you away.
Throw yourself the way you face. No fall damage.

explosion.line: Blasts that can't hurt you. Big boom, big push.
explosion.name: Explosion

nodes.d: Turn it on. Your blasts can't hurt you.
Hold to charge. Let go to blow up where you look.
Blow up everything around you.
Hold to fire small blasts.

explosion_am.line: Blasts that can't hurt you. Big boom, big push.
explosion_am.name: Explosion

nodes.d: Hold to charge. Let go to blow up where you look.
Blow up everything around you.
Hold to fire small blasts.

explosive_missile.line: Missiles that explode. Fire them in fans that split into bomblets, or lob a siege shell.
explosive_missile.name: Explosive Missiles

nodes.d: Turn it on. Every missile explodes in your aura color.
Fire one heavy missile. It explodes on anything.
Launch five missiles in a fan. Each splits into bomblets.
Lob a siege shell high. It lands in a huge blast.

explosive_missile_am.line: Missiles that explode. Fire them in fans that split into bomblets, or lob a siege shell.
explosive_missile_am.name: Explosive Missiles

nodes.d: Fire one heavy missile. It explodes on anything.
Launch five missiles in a fan. Each splits into bomblets.
Lob a siege shell high. It lands in a huge blast.

flame_claw.line: Burning claws. Get close and keep hitting.
flame_claw.name: Flame Claw

nodes.d: Turn it on. Your claws burn.
Your hits set things on fire.
Blast fire all around you.
Hotter claws. Longer burns.
Dash through enemies, burning them.

flame_claw_am.line: Burning claws. Get close and keep hitting.
flame_claw_am.name: Flame Claw

nodes.d: Your hits set things on fire.
Blast fire all around you.
Hotter claws. Longer burns.
Dash through enemies, burning them.
Turn it on. Your claws burn.
Your hits set things on fire.
Blast fire all around you.
Hotter claws. Longer burns.
Dash through enemies, burning them.
Turn it on. Your claws burn.
Your hits set things on fire.
Blast fire all around you.
Hotter claws. Longer burns.
Dash through enemies, burning them.

fusework.line: Needles that wait. Plant them, then set them all off.
fusework.name: Fusework

nodes.d: Turn it on. Your hits stitch live pins into people.
Snap five needles out. They stick and wait.
Pull the thread. Every pin you planted goes off.
Drive a line of needles into the ground, then rip it open.

fusework_am.line: Needles that wait. Plant them, then set them all off.
fusework_am.name: Fusework

nodes.d: Snap five needles out. They stick and wait.
Pull the thread. Every pin you planted goes off.
Drive a line of needles into the ground, then rip it open.

hand_blade.line: Your forearms become energy blades. Long reach, bleeding cuts.
hand_blade.name: Hand Blade

nodes.d: Turn it on. Your forearms become blades.
Lunge and drive your blade through the first foe. They bleed.
Swing out a crescent of energy. It pierces, and they bleed.

hand_blade_am.line: Your forearms become energy blades. Long reach, bleeding cuts.
hand_blade_am.name: Hand Blade

nodes.d: Lunge and drive your blade through the first foe. They bleed.
Swing out a crescent of energy. It pierces, and they bleed.

healing.line: Healing aura. Mend yourself or someone you mark.
healing.name: Healing

nodes.d: Turn it on. Your healing is ready.
Heal slowly while it's on.
Hold to heal yourself fast.
Mark who you heal. They glow.
Hold to heal your marked target from a distance.
Heal everyone near you at once. Leaves you weak.

healing_am.line: Healing aura. Mend yourself or someone you mark.
healing_am.name: Healing

nodes.d: Heal slowly while it's on.
Hold to heal yourself fast.
Mark who you heal. They glow.
Hold to heal your marked target from a distance.
Heal everyone near you at once. Leaves you weak.

heat_palm.line: Red-hot palms. Burn on contact, smelt by hand.
heat_palm.name: Heat Palm

nodes.d: Turn it on. Your palms glow and burn what they touch.
Thrust a red-hot palm. It hits hard and sets them alight.
Hold an item to cook or smelt it in your hand.

heat_palm_am.line: Red-hot palms. Burn on contact, smelt by hand.
heat_palm_am.name: Heat Palm

nodes.d: Thrust a red-hot palm. It hits hard and sets them alight.
Hold an item to cook or smelt it in your hand.

hollow_mark.line: ORIGIN VIII. A pale brand that grows from runes. Strong monsters drop them, and you spend them at the Codex.
hollow_mark.name: Hollow Mark

nodes.d: Your brand grows only from runes you find and spend at the Codex.
Step through the grey. Where you land, it tears open and hurts foes nearby.
Sneak + Blink: grab something at range and hold it in the air.
Open the eye. Shapes show through stone for a few seconds.
nodes.rqt: Void Gaze or Gray Veil bought at the Codex

nodes.d: Sneak + Void Gaze: a cloud of ash that blinds and chokes.
nodes.rqt: Gray Veil bought at the Codex

nodes.d: A cone of dead air knocks everyone down and turns arrows back.
nodes.rqt: Gale Slam or Briar bought at the Codex

nodes.d: Sneak + Gale Slam: stone thorns rise and hold the ground for you.
Throw a spray of bone splinters.
Sneak + Bone Darts, or a rune in hand: open the Codex and buy favors.

Blink forward. Sneak + press to mark a spot, and again to return to it.
Freeze time in a sphere where you aim. You still move.
Freeze a foe and appear beside them. Then hit with all your stored momentum.
Hit a foe and store the blow in time. It lands a few seconds later.

titan_earth.name: Atlas

nodes.d: Lightning in your parent's color, then the body rises out of the steam.
Grow a stone fist for one big blow.
Raise a stone forearm. It takes most of a hit.
Bring a foot down. Everything near is thrown.
Sweep an arm through what's in front. Left click does it too.
Seize the nearest foe, squeeze, and throw. Right click does it too.
Roar. Everything near is shoved back and slowed.
Climb out of the nape. Holding sneak does it too.
Slam the ground. Three lines of rock spikes burst up in front of you.
Plates of stone that crumble away as they take the blows.
Raise a long wall of rock. It throws anyone standing on it, and Titans caught in it get ground down.
The ground splits open all around you and throws everything on it.

Become a walking volcano. Burning rock rains down, and every fourth stone falls on a foe.

Crackling skin. Whoever strikes it is shocked and stunned.
Hurl a spear of lightning. A strike comes down where it lands.
Call a storm. Lightning strikes the foes around you, again and again.

Raise a thorn wall in an arc. It erupts three times.

A shockwave in every direction. Marked foes are hit harder.

Mark every foe around you for a while.

Spend every stack on an orb that hits like two full punches. It leaves dragonfire and a crater.
Draw or dismiss Dragonbane. It pierces armor and won't leave your hand.
Cycle the Engine's bodies.
nodes.rqt: ten slots and the first trial

nodes.d: Boost slots light one at a time.
Half your cap or more: every hit you take pays Cycles.
Every slot lit. The Engine is owed in full.
Dragonplate: crimson scale and wings. Harmful effects can't land.
Sneak + Fate Breaker: sixty seconds of flight and instant Boosts. Then you die.
DreadScale: black plate, gold edges. Opens the chess board on Dragonbane.
nodes.rqt: a finished Drive and a node bought again

nodes.d: Sneak + Dragonbane in DreadScale: the bulwark.
nodes.rqt: a finished Drive and a node bought again

nodes.d: Sneak + Dragonbane in DreadScale: the healer, haloed and a head taller.
